Lightning Feed¶

Lightning data are pulled from the CLDN feed every 15 minutes. However, the timing scripts is only run once per hours.

The colored bar shows the time since the most recent lightning strike pulled. Coloring denotes potential action. Green - Lightning functioning well. Orange - potential problems with the lightning feed. Red - Need to restart the lightning feed and start a backfill.

Below that are the most recent lightning strike times and locations pulled every 15 minutes from the CLDN feed.
